note: Copy this file to relay-settings.json and change the values. projects_dir: the folder with your code repositories. worktrees_dir (optional): where workers work; without it, <projects_dir>\_worktrees\claude. owner_name (optional): your name for the relay's notes. Only for the Codex wake (bridge-relay.ps1 -EnrollCodex): codex_exe (optional) is the full path of the Codex command, and codex_exec_args (optional) is a list of extra codex exec options, one per entry, such as ["--sandbox", "workspace-write"].
